instructions.title: How to Play
instructions.objective_text: Drag and reorder 5 historical event cards in the correct chronological order. You only get <0>one shot per game</0>—and up to <1>three games per day</1>.
instructions.gameplay_today: Each day, the cards are based on events that happened on that same calendar date in different years — for example, in today’s game, all events took place on a <1>{{today}}</1> from the past.
instructions.gameplay_note: (Note: This feature is coming soon. Currently, events span different dates.)
instructions.gameplay_instructions: Drag the cards horizontally to arrange them from earliest to latest, then hit <0>Submit</0> to lock in your order.
instructions.difficulty_easy: <0>Easy Mode:</0> Cards show clear event titles.
instructions.difficulty_hard: <0>Hard Mode:</0> Cards use playful or cryptic descriptions.
instructions.hint_info: You get <0>one hint per game</0>, and it works differently based on difficulty:
instructions.hint_easy: <0>Easy Mode:</0> Highlights all cards already in the correct position.
instructions.hint_hard: <0>Hard Mode:</0> Reveals clearer, straightforward event descriptions.
instructions.hint_penalty: Using a hint reduces your score per correct card by 50%.
instructions.submit_info: You only get <0>one attempt</0>. After submitting:
instructions.submit_flip: Cards flip to show title, year, description, and image.
instructions.submit_modal: You can <0>click any card</0> to open a modal with more info and links.
instructions.scoring_correctness: Correctness: Points per correctly placed card.
instructions.scoring_difficulty: Difficulty: Hard mode gives more points.
instructions.scoring_hint_penalty: Hint Penalty: Using a hint cuts per-card points in half.
instructions.scoring_perfect: Perfect Bonus: Get a bonus if you place all 5 cards correctly.
instructions.aftergame_info: Click any card to explore extended event info, images, and learning links.
instructions.daily_info: You can play up to <0>3 games per day</0>. New cards drop every day!
instructions.tips_1: Check the ⓘ icon after each round to see your score breakdown.
instructions.tips_2: You earn partial points even if your order isn’t perfect.
instructions.tips_3: Each round sharpens your sense of history. Keep going!
